node: AI-server MLCCs and upstream barium titanate dielectric powders
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI-server MLCC / barium-titanate dielectric-powder node found a narrow US-accessible universe. The cleanest context anchors are Japanese MLCC leaders with OTC ADRs, while the underfollowed discovery lane is mainly OTC foreign ordinaries and one US-listed passive-components supplier. The highest-purity underfollowed candidate is Sakai Chemical via OTC SACIF, but its US liquidity/listing quality and direct AI-server revenue evidence require verification. Vishay is a US-listed mid-cap second-order candidate, but its AI-server thin-layer MLCC exposure is currently only a hypothesis, not a proven chokepoint link.
